title: blessed/publication-attestation/v1
description: Proof that every immutable object for a candidate is published or independently verified at the surface. The PR application layer REQUIRES a complete attestation bound to the exact candidate, surface plan, immutable manifest, and object set. An event or a plan alone must NEVER authorize a pointer PR: a pointer that goes live before its bytes exist is a broken surface. Modeled on the receiver's docsort.io/surface-publication-attestation/v1 and promoted to a Blessed schema.

candidate_sha256.description: Digest of the exact release-candidate.json these objects were published for. An attestation for a different candidate is a mismatch, not a partial success.

complete.description: Must be true. A partial publication cannot authorize a pointer move.
